SELECT w_state, i_item_id,
       SUM(CASE WHEN (CAST(d_date AS DATE) < CAST('2001-05-02' AS DATE)) THEN cs_sales_price - COALESCE(cr_refunded_cash, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS sales_before,
       SUM(CASE WHEN (CAST(d_date AS DATE) >= CAST('2001-05-02' AS DATE)) THEN cs_sales_price - COALESCE(cr_refunded_cash, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS sales_after
FROM warehouse
JOIN catalog_sales ON cs_warehouse_sk = w_warehouse_sk AND d_date_sk BETWEEN (SELECT date_sk FROM date_dim WHERE d_date = '2001-04-02') AND (SELECT date_sk FROM date_dim WHERE d_date = '2001-06-01')
JOIN item ON i_item_sk = cs_item_sk
LEFT OUTER JOIN catalog_returns ON cs_order_number = cr_order_number AND cs_item_sk = cr_item_sk
WHERE i_current_price BETWEEN 0.99 AND 1.49
GROUP BY w_state, i_item_id
ORDER BY w_state, i_item_id
LIMIT 100
